Solar Pro 4 is Upstage's flagship model, specialized for agentic use. It is particularly strong at document-based work, coding, and business-related tasks, and substantially improves agent performance compared to Solar Pro 3. It supports a 512K context length with full English, Korean, and Japanese coverage.
